column1: # The checks of shell/callback-forms-password.nsh. See check-shell-log.sh.
# the reads of the store request the setting, never the password's bytes
# a question whose FormSet has a disabled form with a PASSWORD question calls no Callback()

column3: .responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | test("^<ValueUnavailable: the form 2 of the FormSet 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000001A14, whose EFI_IFR_CHECKBOX op is malformed; UEFI 2\\.11 .*33\\.2\\.5\\.10\\.1 disables the form of a malformed op: .*; that form holds an EFI_IFR_PASSWORD, so uefisettings cannot tell which stores a restore through RouteConfig\\(\\) would change>$"))

column1: # without --i-am-fine-to-brick-this-system, set refuses in this HiiDB before any Callback()

column3: . == {"error_message": "this HiiDB declares a setup password question, and the UEFI Shell runs no setup browser, so no password is asked or checked; pass --i-am-fine-to-brick-this-system to write without it"}

column1: # with it, set warns of the setup password and calls the driver; a changed store that holds a

column3: ^warning: this HiiDB declares a setup password question, and the UEFI Shell runs no setup browser, so no password is asked or checked; --i-am-fine-to-brick-this-system lets uefisettings write without it$

.error_message | startswith("after 1 unsafe operation(s) that --i-am-fine-to-brick-this-system let through: ") and contains("not applied: the Callback sequence changed VarStore 0x0005, which holds a PASSWORD question; it was not restored, because a RouteConfig() without the password bytes may clear it; the driver's Callback(FORM_CLOSE) had already run") and (contains("CallbackPassword") | not)
